donkey — AI agent system entry point.

Architecture (post-refactor):

globalOutbox: AsyncQueueOutboundMessage — all orchestrators write here. Daemon loop is async; Telegram uses pollTimeout=0 (non-blocking per iter). Each iteration: drain globalOutbox → drain Discord → poll Telegram → yield. Orchestrators are asyncSpawn tasks; debounce lives in collectWithDebounce (withTimeout, timer-exact). Streaming uses an OS thread + Channelstring.

Stream routing: OutboundMessage.streamId non-empty → streaming turn. streamMsgIdsstreamId = (channel, channelMsgId):

- first partial: send new message, store id
- subsequent partials: editMessage
- isPartial=false: editMessage + delete from streamMsgIds
